constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("actorUserId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY ("translationId") REFERENCES "Translation"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX "TranslationContentRevision_actorUserId_idx" ON public."TranslationContentRevision" USING btree ("actorUserId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "TranslationContentRevision_pkey" ON public."TranslationContentRevision" USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX "TranslationContentRevision_translationId_createdAt_id_idx" ON public."TranslationContentRevision" USING btree ("translationId", "createdAt", id)
